The Dallas Cowboys (3-5) visit the Indianapolis Colts (2-6) on Sunday, November 8, at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis. Kickoff is 12:00 p.m. CT (1:00 p.m. ET) on FOX.

Dallas comes in off a 33-30 overtime loss to Arizona last Sunday, a game the Cowboys led 17-3 in the second half before the Cardinals rallied. Indianapolis lost 42-7 at Jacksonville last week, the Colts' fourth straight loss.

Seven Cowboys are listed as questionable, including wide receiver George Pickens (hamstring) and cornerback Joey Porter Jr. (ankle). Wide receiver KaVontae Turpin and linebacker Malachi Lawrence have been ruled out, while safeties Caleb Downs and P.J. Locke cleared concussion protocol and are set to play.

Both teams made big moves at the trade deadline. Dallas added defensive lineman Quinnen Williams, and Indianapolis added cornerback Sauce Gardner.

This is the 18th regular-season meeting between the teams, with Dallas leading the series 11-6. The last meeting was December 4, 2022, a 54-19 Cowboys win.

Sources: Colts.com; NFL injury reports; SI; NBC Sports
